name: Optimum Tech
description: Software development and product consulting. Optimum Tech helps businesses decide what to build, develop the software, and put it to work.
about: Optimum Tech helps businesses decide what to build, develop the software, and put it to work. We combine product thinking with hands-on engineering, drawing on experience building our own products and delivering client projects. Our work covers Elixir and Phoenix applications, AI features and the development workflows that support them.

Bring us an application that needs work, a feature you want to build, or a development process that keeps getting in the way. We can help define the scope, work on implementation and put useful checks around the result. Our public portfolio links to product-owned websites and source repositories. Archived projects are identified as such; their inclusion does not imply current maintenance.
